en_title: Unique Beeswax Craft Experience at Hello Coffee, Hi Honey in Mangmi Alley
en_description: Hello Coffee, Hi Honey, nestled at the end of Mangmi Alley, is a haven where two colors blend in harmony. This premier dessert café, run by a pâtissier trained at Le Cordon Bleu, also features a unique beeswax craft workshop where you can create personalized items with 100% natural beeswax. They host a one-day class that invites you to unleash your creativity with beeswax, a natural material commonly incorporated in Waldorf educational methods. From slicing to assembling to garnishing, every step of meticulous craftsmanship will provide you with a soothing experience. Two notable philosophies guide this artistic café: the exclusive use of 100% natural syrup in their beverages and a commitment to ensuring that all desserts are both wholesome and delightful to the palate.

en_title: Hurshimchung Spa
en_description: Named as Oncheonjang Inn, this district has a long history. A story related to Dongnae Hot Springs tells that during the Silla period, there lived a limping old lady, who found a crane that also limped like her. One day, she saw it flying up strongly in the sky. When approaching where the crane had been, she found a hot spring. After getting soaked in hot water, her aching leg was fully recovered.In fact, Dongnae Hot Springs is rich in minerals that help alleviate pain from arthritis and neuralgia. . Dongnae Hot Springs, which is said to have an excellent healing effect on adult diseases, is well-known as the largest hot spring facility in the East. It boasts grandeur and magnificence that even motivated a bath-themed cartoon. Natural light from the glass ceiling creates a brighter and warmer atmosphere. More than 10 types of baths are available, along with diverse amenities.How would you feel if you see oceanic views leisurely while looking up at the sky overhead in magnificent hot springs in Busan? Does it feel like you’re a nobleman? Come to Busan to take a hot spring tour, relieve your fatigue, and experience the healing power.

en_description: Haeundae Beach first comes to mind when people think about Busan.However, if you find the sun-drenched and hot white sand a bit burdensome, or if you prefer a cool breeze of an air-conditioner indoors,you can visit Busan Aquarium in Haeundae Beach, where you will surely enjoy your holiday. Sea Life Busan Aquarium introduces you to the incredible world of more than 10,000 marine creatures with over 250 species.It presents a spectacular sight consisting of 8 theme zones, an 80m long submarine tunnel, and 2 main aquariums.

en_title: Taekwondo—the spirit of Korea in its stiff uniform called dobok
en_description: Taekwondo is one of Korea’s traditional martial arts. Since adopted as an official Olympic sport for the 2000 Olympic Games in Sydney, Australia, it has been recognized as a global martial art that is enjoyed and practiced by people around the world, with Taekwondo associations being operated in over 200 countries. Aside from being a martial art, it is also a cultural activity that anyone can experience for leisure or sports.

en_title: Enjoy a picnic on the weekend at the farm.
en_description: What should I do this weekend? I’m going to visit the experience farm with a unique natural landscape.The Durufarm offers the highest satisfaction with a chance to pick and experience blueberries in the summer, strawberries in the spring and winter, and sweet potatoes and peanuts in the fall. Eat all you want, pick the fruits, make tasty dishes, and take some home. Visit the prosperous fields of Seobusan Mountain for a highly satisfying experience.
